Draw the reflection as a dimmed, flipped copy of your figure on the window layer, not a true reflection. Hide the crimson stranger (cast.md) in this carriage, since the draft has no stranger plant yet.

suggestions.quote: the split-flap counter over a head; it flips whenever a meeting is used or a plan changes
suggestions.fix: Reuse the split-flap board from ident B as the counter prop. Decide its colour now: ink flaps with paper-cream digits, so crimson stays reserved for the stranger and alarms. suggestions.quote: The packed-food tiffin, empty on your desk. Mom's counter falls, 38 to 37, while you are not there.
suggestions.fix: Make this the one wordless peak: 8 to 10 s, the tiffin lid open, a slow camera drift toward the flap turning 38 to 37 in slow motion, music dropping at or after the flip rather than before it (sound.md #3). Keep your figure out of frame so the counter stays alone on screen.

suggestions.quote: the offer that keeps you away through every festival this year, which drops it to nine, or the job that lets you take the Friday train
suggestions.fix: Stage the choice as two side-on doors or two train platforms left and right, with the counter between them. The figure walks to one at once, so there is no held pause. The new props are the festival lights and the Friday train; list both as new, and keep the train to a simple layered side-on carriage.

suggestions.quote: She's still at the door. Of course she is.
suggestions.fix: Keep the last 15 s clean: put mom, the door and the corner in the left two-thirds and leave the right third as empty dusk sky. The end-card tags go on the left.
